spans.s: दंश् vt. 1P (pp. दष्ट; pres. दशति; desid. दिदङ्क्षति) To bite, to sting, Bt.xv.4, xvi.19.With उप-, to eat anything as a relish.With सम्-, 1. to bite, Am.
; 2. to stick, सदंष्टवस्त्रेष्वबलनितंबेषु R.xvi.65.
दंश् (II) vt. 10Ā (pres. दंक्षयते) To bite, to sting, e.g. नाहिर्दंशयते कंचित्तद्देशे गरुडाज्ञया.

दंश m. 1. Biting, stinging, मुग्धे विधेहि मयि निर्दयदंतदंशम् Git.G.x.; 2. the sting of a snake; 3. a gadfly, R.ii.5; 4. fault, defect (in a jewel); 5. a tooth; 6. pungency; 7. an armour; 8. a joint, a limb.
दंश-भीरु m. a buffalo.
दंशक m. 1. A dog; 2. a gadfly.
दंशन n. 1. The act of biting, e.g. दष्टाश्च दंशनैः कांतं दासीकुर्वति योषितः; 2. an armour.
दंशित a. (f. ता) 1. Bitten; 2. mailed, furnished with an armour.
दंशित a. (f. ता) 1. Bitten; 2. mailed, furnished with an armour.
दंशिन् m. The same as दंशक q.v.
दंशी f. A small gadfly.
दंष्ट्रा f. A large tooth, a tusk, a fang, दंष्ट्राभंगं मृगाणामधिपतय इव … … नाज्ञाभंगं सहंते नृवर नृपतयस्त्वादृशाः सार्वभौमाः Mud.iii., R.ii.46.
दंष्ट्रा-अस्त्र, -आयुध m. a wild boar.
दंष्ट्रा-अस्त्र, -आयुध m. a wild boar.
दंष्ट्रा-कराल a. having terrible tusks.
दंष्ट्रा-विष m. a kind of snake.
दंष्ट्राल a. (f. ला) Having large tusks.
दंष्ट्राल a. (f. ला) Having large tusks.
दंष्ट्रिका f. the same as दंष्ट्रा q.v.
दंष्ट्रिन् m. 1. A boar; 2. a snake.
दंड् vi. 10U (pp. दंडित; pres. दंडयति-ते) (This is one of those verbs which take two accusatives, e.g. प्रजाः शतं दंडयति राजा.) To fine, to punish, स्थित्यै दंडयतो दंडश्चान् R.i.25.

दंड (I) m.n. 1. A stick, a staff, a cudgel, a mace, परस्य दंडं नोद्यच्छेत् M.iv.164; 2. the sceptre of a king; 3. the staff given to a twice-born man at the time of investiture with the sacred thread; 4. the staff carried by a Sannyāsin; 5. the trunk of an elephant; 6. a stalk, the stem of a tree, the handle of anything, ब्रह्मांडच्छत्रदंडः … भुवनांभोरुहो नालदंडः D.K., राज्यं स्वहस्तधृतदंडमिवातपत्रम् Sak.v., K.S.vii.89; 7. the oar of a boat; 8. a churning stick; 9. a measure of length equal to four hands, a rod of that length used for the purpose of taking measurements; 10. the penis; 11. a form of military array; 12. an army, तस्य दंडवतो दंडः स्वदेहान्न व्यशिष्यत R.xvii.62, Kir.ii.12; 13. control, restraint, वाग्दंडोऽथ मनोदंडः कायदंडस्तथैव च । यस्यैते निहिता बुद्धौ त्रिदंडीति स उच्यते M.xii.10; 14. punishment, corporal chastisement (as राजदंड, धर्मदंड), R.i.6, M.vii.103; 15. imprisonment; 16. the last of the four ways of dealing with an enemy, viz., violence, war, punishment; See उपायचतुष्टय, Sis.ii.54, M.vii.109; 17. pride; 18. the body.
दंड (II) m. 1. An epithet of Yama; 2. of Viṣṇu; 3. of Śiva; 4. an attendant on the sun; 5. a horse.

दंड-अजिन n. 1. staff and skin (collectively), 2. hypocrisy^1, deceit.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260516. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/224.
दंड-अधिप m. chief magistrate.
दंड-अनीक n. a division of an army, a detachment.

दंड-अपूपन्याय m. the maxim of the staff and cakes. It denotes that when one thing is connected with another in a particular way, what is predicable of the one is, as a matter of course, predicable of the other also; as when a staff and cakes are kept together the pulling of the staff by a cat naturally leads one to expect the pulling of the cakes also.
दंड-अर्ह a. deserving punishment.
दंड-अलसिका f. cholera.
दंड-आज्ञा f. judicial sentence.
दंड-आहत n. butter-milk.
दंड-कर्मन् n. infliction of punishment, chastisement.
दंड-काक m. a raven.
दंड-काष्ठ n. a wooden staff.
दंड-ग्रहण n. assumption of the staff of a yati, becoming a mendicant.
दंड-च्छदन n. a room in which utensils of various kinds are kept.
दंड-ढक्का f. a kind of drum.
दंडादंडि ind. (fighting) with sticks and staves.
दंड-दास m. one who has become a slave from non-payment of a debt.
दंड-देवकुल n. a court of justice.
दंड-धर, -धार (I) a. carrying a staff.
दंड-धर, -धार (I) a. carrying a staff.
दंड-धार (II) m. 1. an epithet of Yama; 2. a king, श्रमनुदं मनुदंडधरान्वयम् R.ix.3.
दंड-नायक m. 1. a judge, a head police-officer; 2. the leader of an army, a general.
दंड-नीति f. 1. administration of justice, judicature; 2. system of civil and military administration, polity, ethics, R.xviii.46.
दंड-नेतृ m. a king.
दंड-पात m. 1. falling of a stick; 2. inflicting punishment.
दंड-प m. a king.
दंड-पांशुल m. a porter, a door-keeper.
दंड-पाणि m. an epithet of Yama.
दंड-पातन n. infliction of punishment.
दंड-पारुष्य n. strict, harsh or cruel infliction of punishment.
दंड-पाल, -पालक m. 1. a head magistrate; 2. a doorkeeper, a porter.
दंड-पाल, -पालक m. 1. a head magistrate; 2. a doorkeeper, a porter.
दंड-पोण n. a filtering machine with a handle.
दंड-प्रणाम m. bowing without bending the body (keeping it like a stick).
दंड-बालधि m. an elephant.
दंड-भंग m. non-execution of a sentence.
दंड-भृत् m. 1. a potter; 2. an epithet of Yama.
दंड-माथ m. a principal road, a highway.
दंड-यात्रा f. 1. a solemn procession; 2. warlike expedition, conquest.
दंड-याम m. 1. an epithet of Yama; 2. of the sage Agastya; 3. a day.
दंड-वादिन्, -वासिन् m. a doorkeeper.
दंड-वादिन्, -वासिन् m. a doorkeeper.
दंड-वाहिन् m. a police-officer.
दंड-विधि m. criminal law.
दंड-विष्कंभ m. the post to which the string of a churning stick is fastened.
दंड-व्यूह m. a particular military array.
दंड-शास्त्र n. criminal law.
दंड-हस्त m. 1. a doorkeeper, a porter; 2. an epithet of Yama.
दंडक m. (often used in the plural) Name of a district in the Dekkan between the Narmadā and Godāvarī, uninhabited in the time of Rāma, प्राप्तानि दुःखान्यपि दंडकेषु R.xiv.25.
दंडका f. The same as दंडक q.v., क्वायोध्यायाः पुनरुपगमो दंडकायां वने वः Ut.ii., किंनाम दम्डकेयम् ibid.
दंडन n. Punishing, chastising.
दंडार m. 1. A furious elephant; 2. a potter’s wheel; 3. a raft, a boat.
दंडिक m. A staff-bearer, a mace-bearer.
दंडिका f. 1. A stick; 2. a row, a line; 3. a string of pearls, a necklace.
दांडिक m. A chastiser, a punisher.

दंडिन् m. 1. A Brāhmaṇa of the fourth order, a Sannyāsin; 2. a door-keeper; 3. an epithet of Yama; 4. a king; 5. name of a poet, author of Kāvyādarsa and Daśakumāracharita, e.g. जाते जगति वाल्मीके कविरित्यभिधाऽभवत् । कवी
इति ततो
व्यासे कवयस्त्वयि दंडिनि ॥
दनु f. Name of a daughter of Daksha, who was wife of Kaśyapa and mother of the Danavas.
दनु-ज m. a demon.
दनु-ज˚अरि, ˚द्विष् m. a god.
दनु-ज˚अरि, ˚द्विष् m. a god.
दनु-संभव, -सूनु m. a demon.
दनु-संभव, -सूनु m. a demon.
दंत m. 1. A tooth, a tusk, शिखिनो नंदति मेघागमे कुंदसमानदंति
Ghat.2
, R.v.72; 2. an elephant’s tusk, ivory; 3. the point of an arrow; 4. the peak of a mountain; 5. a bower, an arbour.
दांत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Tamed, subdued, bridled; 2. resigned, (pp. of दम् q.v.)
दांत (II) m. 1. The Damanaka tree; 2. a tamed ox.
दांत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Tamed, subdued, bridled; 2. resigned, (pp. of दम् q.v.)
दंत-अग्र n. the point of a tooth.
दंत-अंतर m. the space between the teeth.
दंत-अर्बुद m.n. ulceration of the gums.
दंत-आघात m. a bite.
दंत-आयुध m. a wild boar.
दंत-आलिका, -आली f. a horse’s bridle.
दंत-आलिका, -आली f. a horse’s bridle.
दंत-उच्छिष्ट n. the remains of food lodged between the teeth.
दंत-उद्भेद m. dentition.
दंत-उलूखलीक m. an anchorite of a particular order, M.vi.17.
दंत-कर्षण m. the citron tree.
दंत-कार m. an artist who works in ivory.
दंत-काष्ठ n. a piece of stick used as a tooth-brush.
दंत-कूर m. fight.
दंत-ग्राहिन् a. injuring the teeth, causing them to decay.
दंत-घर्ष m. chattering of the teeth.
दंत-चाल m. looseness of the teeth.
दंत-च्छद m. the lip, दंतच्छदैर्दंतविघातचिह्नैः Rt.iv.12.
दंतादंति ind. biting one another (tooth against tooth).
दंत-जात a. (a child) that is teething.
दंत-जाह n. the root of a tooth.
दंत-धावन (I) m. 1. the khadira tree; 2. the bakula tree.
दंत-धावन (II) n. 1. washing the teeth; 2. a tooth-brush.
दंत-पत्र n. a kind of ear-ornament, K.S.vii.23.
दंत-पत्रक n. a kunda flower.
दंत-पत्रिका f. a kunda flower.
दंत-पवन n. 1. a tooth-brush; 2. washing the teeth.
दंत-पात m. the falling out of the teeth.
दंत-पाली f. the point of a tooth.
दंत-पुष्प n. 1. the kunda flower; 2. fruit of the clearing-nut plant.
दंत-प्रक्षालन n. washing the teeth.
दंत-भाग m. the forepart of an elephant’s head.
दंत-मय a. made of ivory.
दंत-मल n. the tartar of the teeth.
दंत-मांस, -मूल, -वल्क n. gums.
दंत-मांस, -मूल, -वल्क n. gums.
दंत-मांस, -मूल, -वल्क n. gums.
दंत-मूलीय m. pl. the dental letters, viz., ऌ, त्, थ्, द्, ध्, न्, ल् and स्.
दंत-रोग m. tooth-ache.
दंत-वस्त्र, -वासस् n. the lip, तुलां यदारोहति दंतवाससा K.S.v.34.
दंत-वस्त्र, -वासस् n. the lip, तुलां यदारोहति दंतवाससा K.S.v.34.
दंत-बीज, -वीज, बीजक, -वीजक n. the pomegranate tree.
दंत-बीज, -वीज, बीजक, -वीजक n. the pomegranate tree.
दंत-बीज, -वीज, बीजक, -वीजक n. the pomegranate tree.
दंत-बीज, -वीज, बीजक, -वीजक n. the pomegranate tree.
दंत-वीणा f. 1. a kind of musical instrument; 2. chattering of the teeth.
दंत-वैदर्भ m. loosening of the teeth through external injury.
दंत-व्यसन n. fracture of the teeth.
दंत-शठ (I) a. sour, acid.
दंत-शठ (II) m. the citron tree.
दंत-शर्करा f. tartar of the teeth.
दंत-शाण m. a kind of tooth-powder.
दंत-शूल m. tooth-ache.
दंत-शोधनि f. a tooth-pick.
दंत-शोफ m. swelling of the gums.
दंत-संघर्ष m. gnashing the teeth.
दंत-हर्ष m. morbid sensitiveness of the teeth.
दंत-हर्षक m. the citron tree.
दंतक m. 1. A peak, a summit; 2. a pin or shelf projecting from a wall.
दंतावल m. An elephant, Bh.V.i.60, R.i.71.
दंतावल m. An elephant, Bh.V.i.60, R.i.71.
दंतुर a. (f. रा) 1. Having long or projecting teeth, e.g. शूकरे निहते चैव दंतुरो जायते नरः; 2. notched, serrated, uneven; 3. undulatory; 4. rising, bristling.
दंतुर a. (f. रा) 1. Having long or projecting teeth, e.g. शूकरे निहते चैव दंतुरो जायते नरः; 2. notched, serrated, uneven; 3. undulatory; 4. rising, bristling.
दंतुर-च्छद m. the lime tree.
दंतुरित a. (f. ता) 1. Having prominent teeth; 2. toothed, notched, bristling, केतकिदंतुरिताशे Git.G.i., विपुलपुलकभरदंतुरितम् xi.
दंतुरित a. (f. ता) 1. Having prominent teeth; 2. toothed, notched, bristling, केतकिदंतुरिताशे Git.G.i., विपुलपुलकभरदंतुरितम् xi.
दंत्य m. A letter of the dental class; See दंतमूलीय.
दंदश m. A tooth.
दंदशूक (I) a. (f. का) Venomous, mischievous.
दंदशूक (II) m. 1. A demon, इषुमति रघुसिंहे दंदशूकाञ्जिघांसौ Bt.i.26; 2. a snake; 3. a reptile.
दंदशूक (I) a. (f. का) Venomous, mischievous.
दंभ् vt. 5P (pp. दब्ध; pres. दभ्नोति; desid. धिप्सति, धीप्सति, दिदंभिषति) 1. To injure, to hurt; 2. to go; 3. to deceive.
दंभ् (II) vt. 10U (pp. दंभयति-ते) To send, to impel, to propel.
दंपती m. du. Man and wife, R.i.35, ii.70, M.iii.116.
दंभ m. 1. Deceit, fraud, roguery; 2. religious hypocrisy, Bg.xvi.4; 3. arrogance, ostentation; 4. sin, wickedness; 5. the thunderbolt of Indra.
दंभन n. Cheating, deceiving, deceit.
दंभिन् m. A hypocrite, an impostor.
दंभोलि m. Indra’s thunderbolt.
दांडाजिनिक (I) a. (f. की) Carrying a staff and hide as outward signs of religion.
दांडाजिनिक (II) m. A cheat, a hypocrite.
दांडाजिनिक (I) a. (f. की) Carrying a staff and hide as outward signs of religion.
दान् vt. 1U (pres. दीदांसति-ते in the first sense; दानति-ते in the second) 1. To make straight; 2. to cut, to divide.

दान n. 1. Giving, delivering, K.S.v.15; 2. a gift, a present, Bg.xvii.20; 3. liberality, charity, R.i.69; 4. bribery as one of the four means by which a king overpowers his enemies (in civil polity) See उपायचतुष्टय; 5. the juice flowing from the temples of an elephant, rut, ichor, R.ii.7, iv.45, v.43; 6. cutting, dividing; 7. purification; 8. protection; 9. pasture.
दान-कुल्या f. the flow of fluid from an elephant’s temples.
दान-धर्म m. alms-giving, charity.
दान-पति m. 1. an exceedingly munificent man; 2. Akrūra, a friend of Kṛṣṇa.
दान-पत्र n. a deed of gifts.
दान-पात्र n. a Brāhmaṇa fit to receive gifts.
दान-प्रतिभाव्य n. security for payment of a debt.
दान-भिन्न a. made hostile by bribes.

दान-वीर m. 1. an exceedingly liberal man; 2. the sentiment of heroism based on liberality, i.e. the sentiment of enthusiastic liberality (in rhetoric). The following is an instance- कियदिदमधिकं मे यद्द्विजायार्थायित्रे कवचमरमणीयं कुंडले चार्पयामि । अकरुणमवकृत्य द्राक्कृपाणेन निर्यद्बहलरुधिरधारं मौलिमावेदयामि R.G.
दान-शूर, -शौंड m. an exceedingly liberal man.
दान-शूर, -शौंड m. an exceedingly liberal man.
दानक n. A mean gift.
दानव m. A demon, a Rākṣasa, Bg.x.14.
दानव-अरि m. 1. a god; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
दानव-गुरु m. an epithet of Śukra.
दानवेय m. The same as दानव q.v.
दांति f. Self-restraint, subjection.
दांतिक a. (f. का) Made of ivory.
दांतिक a. (f. का) Made of ivory.
दांपत्य n. Matrimony, the matrimonial relation.
दांभिक a. (f. की) 1. Deceitful, hypocritical; 2. proud, ostentatious.
दांभिक a. (f. की) 1. Deceitful, hypocritical; 2. proud, ostentatious.
